expansion.fileHashHint: Drop files here. Files are hashed locally in chunks. Up to 100 files.
expansion.invalid: Invalid input. Check the values and try again.
expansion.setCounts: {count} results. Duplicates in A {a}, in B {b}.
expansion.invalidImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 25 MiB and 32 million pixels.
expansion.qrHint: Upload, drop or paste a PNG, JPEG or WebP image here. Processing stays in your browser.
expansion.tableHint: Import CSV or TSV files, up to 5 MB, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. Merge aligns columns by name.
expansion.invalidTable: Invalid table. Check delimiters, unique headers, column counts and file limits.
expansion.previewLimit: Preview shows the first 100 rows. Download includes all processed rows.
expansion.columnsHint: Columns to export, one per line (empty selects all)
expansion.sqlHint: CSV values stay strings. JSON preserves numbers, booleans and null. Missing fields become NULL. Table names are quoted as one identifier.
expansion.invalidSql: Unable to generate SQL. Check the input, table name and batch size.
expansion.dnsHint: Queries run through the server using the selected public resolvers. Results include TTL in seconds and DNS status codes. Cached answers may differ.
expansion.networkFailed: Request failed. Check the target, settings and network connection.
expansion.tlsHint: Checks the public domain on port 443 from this server. Reports the negotiated TLS version, certificate chain, hostname and validity period.
expansion.wsHint: WebSocket connects from your browser. Heartbeats send text messages. Use wss on HTTPS sites. Browser connections support URL and subprotocol authentication.
expansion.sseHint: SSE connects through the server to public HTTP(S) targets. GET and POST are supported. Each connection lasts up to 60 seconds or 2 MiB.
expansion.logHint: Shows the latest 500 entries, up to 20,000 characters per entry.
expansion.cronHint: Five-field Unix cron. Choose an IANA time zone for previews. Monthly dates that do not exist are skipped.
expansion.invalidCron: Check the schedule, time zone and numeric ranges.
expansion.repairHint: Review the original input and repaired output before copying. Repair can infer missing punctuation or values.
expansion.invalidJsonRepair: Cannot convert this input to standard JSON. Check syntax, finite numbers and safe JSON5 integers. Use Repair JSON for large decimal integers.
expansion.modelHint: Generated models infer types from samples. Java uses Jackson annotations, C# uses System.Text.Json. Array or primitive roots use a value wrapper.
expansion.uploadHint: Upload up to 8 MiB total. Multipart requests export as cURL. Place local files beside the command before running it.
expansion.batchImageHint: Up to 30 images, 100 MiB total. Resize preserves proportions and applies the same rotation. JPEG uses a white background.
expansion.batchImageError: Unable to process this batch. Check image formats, sizes and dimensions.
expansion.searchHint: Search by name, keyword or task. Use Tab and Enter to open a result.
